paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.36% on average, with DAX strongest (+3.60%) and Hang Seng weakest (-3.45%). Brent crude changed -0.48% to 92.13. Gold changed -6.11% to 3,863.3. Bitcoin changed -12.87% to 64,447.1211. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.121%, a relative move of +5.28%. Among the firms tracked, Gold Miners (ETF) (-13.68%) and Vale (-12.61%) moved the most.
